member.name: T:Realm.MapAPI.ILobbyAPI
member.summary: The roster a map script owns while its lobby is filling: which factions the map offers, how many players it seats, and what faction, team and colour each player slot holds. It is handed to while the authority sits at tick zero, before any match exists.

remarks.para: Reads are taken straight out of the shared roster the authority publishes, so they cost no host call and never allocate. Writes are orders to the authority, which applies them to the lobby the players are sitting in, so a write can be refused - a locked slot, a slot nobody holds, a faction the map does not offer, or a full lobby - and reports whether it was accepted.

A lock is what a map offers a player as a choice it may not change: a script sets a slot's faction, team or colour and locks it, and the lobby stops offering that field for that seat. A map that sets nothing leaves the lobby's own assignment of colours and teams in place, which is what the default lobby rules do.
